summary: Preserve private static brand semantics when an inherited static method accesses `this.#x`.

target.notes: Perform a private-brand check against the runtime constructor object used as `this`; do not always read the defining class's CLR static field.

semantics.subclass_inherited_m_call: TypeError unless subclass carries the defining private brand (ordinary subclass does not)

caveats: A C# base static method reading a private static field would incorrectly succeed when invoked through the derived type.

tests.name: defining class succeeds
tests.input: class A { static #x=1; static m(){return this.#x;} } console.log(A.m());

tests.name: edge: subclass call brand-fails
tests.input: class A { static #x=1; static m(){return this.#x;} } class B extends A {} B.m();
